merchant_id.cause: privacy layer ingest schema (IngestTransactionRequest) has NO merchant-name/merchant-id field; FeatureVector.merchant_id defaults to ''; _from_raw_native maps merchant_id->merchant_name->_code('')=0.0 constant. Offline trained on real merchant hash codes.

user_merchant_diversity.cause: FeatureVector default 0.0 -> derive clamps max(0,1.0)=1.0 constant; offline used real distinct-merchant counts.

user_city_diversity.cause: same clamp; offline used real distinct-city counts.

user_merch_count.cause: FeatureVector default 0; UserVelocityTracker never tracks per-user-merchant interaction counts.

user_fraud_rate.cause: wired path feeds 0.0 default -> COLD_START_FRAUD_RATE 0.001 constant.

user_avg_amt.cause: float32 storage of offline cache vs float64 prod; delta equals tolerance exactly (rounding boundary)

amt_vs_user_avg.cause: divides by user_avg_amt; tiny denominator errors amplify at the 4-decimal rounding boundary

48_feature_matrix.note: The 3 precision-boundary failures affect <0.08% of rows at exactly the 1e-4 tolerance boundary (float32 storage vs float64 compute); the 7 semantic failures affect 48-100% of rows and are material.

edge_cases_20.note: when context inputs are identical, the shared derivation (derive_native_features) produces identical vectors on all 20 edge cases (normal, zero amount, missing amount->0.0 boundary, NaN, unseen entities, channels, extreme amounts, malformed fields).

cache_reset_regression.note: unrelated prior state does not contaminate later events; first-observed row always sees empty context; amount=0 is a value, not missing.

temporal_parity.note: production UserVelocityTracker/EntityFraudRateTracker accumulate in INGESTION order with no ts parameter; a backdated/future-dated row ingested early leaks into earlier-dated rows' features. Offline sorts by ts before expanding context (by construction). Material semantic divergence for replay/backdate workloads.

fraud_rate_parity_split.note: numerical parity and label availability are reported separately; a tracker that numerically matched offline would still not resolve Gate A.

score_parity.note: 22.5% of sampled shadow rows flip the tV* decision between offline scoring and production-path scoring, driven by the 7 semantic feature divergences.

precision_audit.note: both paths cast to float32 before scaling (matches training); measured deltas recorded.

zero_value_audit.falsy_default_patterns: 40 candidate regex hits reviewed; the wired 0.0->0.001 cold-start fraud-rate conversion is the documented COLD_START_FRAUD_RATE behavior, not a zero->missing bug.

material_divergences: merchant_id is a constant 0.0 in production-as-wired (privacy layer never forwards merchant identity) — 100% of rows diverge from training
user_merchant_diversity / user_city_diversity are constant 1.0 (clamp of the 0.0 default) — ~99% of rows diverge
user_merch_count is constant 0.0 — 85% of rows diverge

user/merch/city fraud rates are constant 0.001 cold-start in production-as-wired — 48-58% of rows diverge; even the EntityFraudRateTracker variant (100-event window, min-5) differs from the offline unbounded expanding mean
production trackers have no timestamp cutoff — out-of-order/backdated ingestion changes earlier rows' features (offline sorts by ts)
score parity shows 22.5% decision disagreements at the frozen threshold tV*
gate_b_decision_verb: Material offline/production feature divergence is PROVEN by execution: 7 of 48 features are semantically divergent in production-as-wired (48-100% of rows), temporal semantics diverge for out-of-order ingestion, and 22.5% of threshold decisions flip between offline and production scoring.
